column1: # Credential-store slug to OpenShell profile mapping for claude-oss provider
# Columns, tab-separated (the same format as examples/providers/catalog.tsv,
#   store       maki | opencode (the credential store the slug comes from)
#   slug        provider id as stored by that agent
# Only Anthropic API keys map to a curated claude-* profile. No store holds a
# Claude subscription token: create one with `claude setup-token` on the host
# and give it to provider setup through --env, --file, or the hidden prompt.
# The example model for each profile is in catalog.tsv.
